years_since_diagnosis.evidence: diagnosed with Crohn's five years ago

location.evidence: Colonoscopy showed Crohn's in my ileum and cecum.

severity.evidence: Been stable on Humira for two years now, though I still have mini-flares during my period. The fatigue affects everything - work performance, social life, relationship with my boyfriend.
